title: 1. Your details
lead: We need your RUN or IPE to reproduce the tie-breaking lottery and calculate your chances.
disclaimer: This is a research tool that helps you decide: it does not replace or submit your official SAE application.
idHelp: Enter the RUN or IPE including its final verification digit; dots and hyphen are optional.
idRequiredHint: Enter your RUN/IPE to unlock the analysis.
privacyNote: The calculation runs on this application's server. Your RUN/IPE is not stored in the browser and never appears in the web address.

why.title: Why do we ask for this?
why.body: We use this number to reproduce the official tie-breaking lottery each school runs, which is what decides your place among the applicants.
why.privacy: The number never leaves this tool: it is not submitted anywhere and it does not change your official application.

ties.label: I have not yet decided the exact order between some programs
ties.help: Use this planning option to compare possible orders. Before submitting the official application you will still have to choose the order you genuinely prefer.
ties.info: Give the same preference-group number to the programs you currently consider tied. The app will compare every compatible order, but this exploratory grouping is not submitted to SAE.
